activity_summary: At noon you sat on the right and ate three bites. You did not bring either king to the table as a tale. The morning's clove was spent, and you told Alse not to buy another. The coffer stayed shut. The loaf was a penny and was not measured. You were going back at two.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Ate, and would not name the afternoon's side.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept the plot off the board until the bread was gone.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Was not sent for a clove.

entities.name: a penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in Chalk, and the soft side

facets.activity: Ate three bites with Mistress Ansell and Alse

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Do not go. The jaw is hot and it is mine.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Then the coffer is the wisest body in the house.
